question.problem:
Consider the bilinear form $B(x,y),$ given by 

$$
B(x,y)=2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{1}{y}_{3}-3{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{3}{y}_{1}.
$$

 

Evaluate $B(x,y)$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$\,$ $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,y=[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2} \\ {y}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$

Substituting these into the bilinear expression, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{1}{y}_{3}-3{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{3}{y}_{1} \\  & =2\cdot 3\cdot 5+3\cdot 2-3\cdot 1\cdot 5+2\cdot (-2)\cdot 0 \\  & =30+6-15+0 \\  & =21.\end{aligned}
$$
